initial_plan.intent: Preserve the current successful take, state-action, and move completion sequences, but terminate or broaden search when a required fixture, requested object type, or second object is not present among distinct admissible candidates, and avoid substituting different observed object types.

requirements.text: When the task names a required fixture, surface, or destination and no currently admissible go-to/examine/use for it is present after the named object is held, do not repeat examine-and-move cycles among already visited surfaces. Prefer a different admissible go-to/open/examine toward an unvisited candidate; if none remains and no admissible use can advance, use inventory or look to reassess and then stop rather than continue the alternation.

When a requested object type has not been observed, do not take, heat, cool, clean, or move a different observed object type as if it satisfies the request. Continue searching distinct admissible surfaces or closed containers for the requested type; if no distinct candidate remains and no admissible take of that type is present, use inventory or look and stop rather than process a different type.

After moving the first object in a two-object task, if the returned source no longer offers an admissible take for the required second type, do not retry that empty source or take/move an unrelated object. Search different unvisited admissible surfaces or containers that may contain the second required type; if no distinct candidate or take remains, stop rather than repeat prior no-target locations.

watch.question: Can a named fixture appear only after an unvisited open/go-to, making early stop after currently visible distinct candidates a false termination?
Are there ALFRED task-language cases where the requested type name and observed object type differ but are accepted aliases, so rejecting all different-type takes would break valid completions?

Can a source surface currently empty of the second object later reveal it after another object is moved or a container is opened, which would make stopping after distinct visible candidates premature?

effective_plan.intent: Preserve the current successful take, state-action, and move completion sequences, but terminate or broaden search when a required fixture, requested object type, or second object is not present among distinct admissible candidates, and avoid substituting different observed object types.

requirements.text: When a requested object type has not been observed, do not take, heat, cool, clean, or move a different observed object type as if it satisfies the request. Continue searching distinct admissible surfaces or closed containers for the requested type; if no distinct candidate remains and no admissible take of that type is present, use inventory or look and stop rather than process a different type.

When the task names a required fixture, surface, or destination and no currently admissible go-to/examine/use for it is present after the named object is held, do not repeat the same no-target go-to/examine/move alternation shown in the two recent pre-action observations/actions. Prefer a different currently admissible go-to/open/examine candidate; if none is offered and no admissible use can advance, use inventory or look to reassess, then stop rather than continue the alternation.

After moving the first object in a two-object task, if the returned source no longer offers an admissible take for the required second type, do not retry that source or take/move an unrelated object. Use the current admissible list and the two recent pre-action observations/actions to choose a different go-to/open/examine surface or container that may contain the required second type; if the current list offers no different candidate or admissible take, use inventory or look to reassess, then stop rather than repeat recent no-target locations.

outputs/fusion.reason: The current draft already preserves the successful single-object, state-action, and same-source two-object completions. Its search clauses, however, rely on visited/unvisited wording that the stated capability does not support: the actor has only the current observation/admissible list plus the last two pre-action observations/actions. P1 and P8 show repeated no-target locations, so replace u1/u3 with executable recent-pattern non-repetition while retaining stop and reassessment bounds. Memory m3 keeps this bounded: last-two search is not a proven solution.
